facts.fact: The Mauritius Standards Bureau Act establishes the Mauritius Standards Bureau and a Standards Council, and the Minister made the Certification Mark Regulations 2026 (GN No. 46 of 2026) under section 33 of that Act on the Council's recommendation.

systems.owner: Government of Mauritius, under the Mauritius Standards Bureau Act

note: Certification mark regulations cover commodities and processes against Mauritian standards generally and name no IT or data standard, so no certification fact and no published fact; quality-plan certification is class other.
